name: Do I need to secure all permits upfront for a multi-phase project?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to secure all permits upfront for a multi-phase project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Securing all necessary permits upfront for the entire scope of a multi-phase project is often advisable, though specific requirements can vary by municipality in areas like Los Angeles or San Marino. Obtaining permits early can streamline the process and prevent delays between phases. However, in some cases, certain permits might be phase-dependent or require updated information closer to a specific construction stage. Your project manager will guide you through the local permitting landscape to ensure compliance and efficiency.
acceptedAnswer.description: While often advisable, permit requirements vary; your project manager will guide you on securing permits for each phase based on local regulations.
